user.title: Parcel Tracker
user.description:
Enter your API keys below to enable reliable tracking. Both are free and optional — you can also add them later via the integration settings.

**DHL API Key** (DHL Express + DHL Germany) — Free, 250 calls/day. Register at [{dhl_url}]({dhl_url}), create an app and copy the **Consumer Key**.

**17track API Key** (DPD, GLS, Mondial Relay, 4PX + everything else) — Free, 100 trackings/month. Register at [{seventeentrack_url}]({seventeentrack_url}), go to **Settings → Security → Access Key**.

data_description.postal_code: Needed by bpost and Colis Privé to return tracking data (e.g. 9090)
